en.title: GTA 6 Pre-Orders Skyrocket to Nearly 8 Million, PS5 Dominates
en.summary: Grand Theft Auto VI is shattering pre-order records, with data indicating nearly eight million copies have already been secured. PlayStation 5 owners are leading the charge, making up a significant majority of these early commitments.
en.body:
The anticipation for Rockstar Games' **Grand Theft Auto VI** is reaching a fever pitch, with new data from Sensor Tower revealing that pre-orders are rapidly approaching the eight million mark. This staggering figure, gathered from digital storefronts, positions **GTA VI** for an absolutely monumental launch, even before its official release date. The demand is so intense that it's already challenging the pre-launch numbers of previous blockbuster titles, showcasing the immense cultural footprint of the **Grand Theft Auto** franchise.

Sensor Tower's analysis indicates that a commanding 74% of these estimated pre-orders have been placed on the **PlayStation 5**. This translates to roughly 4.8 million copies and an estimated $468 million in revenue for Sony's console alone. In contrast, the **Xbox Series X|S** accounts for approximately 26% of pre-orders, equating to around 1.66 million copies and $162 million. While these numbers are still substantial, the clear preference for the **PlayStation 5** for this particular title is a notable trend.

## A Franchise Built on Hype

This level of front-loaded demand is almost unprecedented, making traditional forecasting models challenging for analysts. Sensor Tower itself has cautioned that the unusual nature of **GTA 6**'s demand curve, even with less than a month until release, requires careful observation. The firm adjusted its model in early October to better reflect estimated country splits, demonstrating the dynamic and evolving nature of tracking such a highly anticipated game. The current estimated 6.45 million digital pre-orders have already generated over $630 million, a testament to the franchise's enduring appeal and the sheer scale of **Rockstar Games**' ambition.

## Fan Frenzy and Console Wars

For fans, these numbers are more than just statistics; they represent the collective excitement and investment in what is poised to be one of the biggest entertainment launches of all time. The strong **PlayStation 5** showing is a significant win for Sony, potentially reinforcing its position in the current console generation, especially for high-profile, multi-platform releases. The data also suggests a continued appetite for premium, single-player experiences, despite the rise of live-service models. The race to secure a copy and dive into **Vice City** is clearly on, with millions of players eager to experience **Rockstar**'s next open-world masterpiece.

## What's Next

With **Grand Theft Auto VI** set to launch in Spring 2025, the pre-order numbers are expected to continue climbing. Players should keep an eye on official channels for any further updates or potential Collector's Edition announcements as the release date approaches.
